source_discrepancies.resolution: The versioned 3.2.1 Video Summarization documentation lists 13 MCP tools, including add_file, list_files, get_file_info, and delete_file, while both pinned repository implementations register nine tools. Keep the four missing tools as a blocked upstream/source gap and accept only the exact nine-tool runtime surface until source alignment is implemented and qualified.

The versioned 3.2.1 documentation advertises an 18-model RT-VLM matrix while the tagged/current repository README advertises 11. Preserve the documented superset as the product contract and keep absent exact artifacts unqualified until NVIDIA aligns the sources.

The versioned VSS 3.2.1 Edge Deployment page, updated 2026-07-16, specifies nvidia/NVIDIA-Nemotron-3-Nano-4B-FP8 for AGX/IGX Thor, while the current checkout skill retains nvidia/NVIDIA-Nemotron-Edge-4B-v2.1-EA-020126_FP8. Follow the later versioned documentation for the official lane and retain the checkout model only as an older unqualified fallback.
The release-specific 3.2.1 default of Cosmos3 Nano overrides older Base and RT-VLM default prose. Repository-local alternate models do not establish equivalence.
